b2-01-01.title: Communicative Challenge: What Matters Most
b2-01-01.scenario: You are Meg. You and Carlos live in Budapest, and he asks what interests you most about your course. The part that interests you most is the historical background of the crisis.
b2-01-01.prompt: Tell Carlos what interests you most about your course.
b2-01-01.target: Lo que más me interesa es el trasfondo histórico de la crisis.
b2-01-01.english: What interests me most is the historical background of the crisis.
b2-01-01.canDo: I can build cleft sentences with 'lo que' and 'ser' to spotlight an idea.

b2-01-02.title: Communicative Challenge: Frankly Speaking
b2-01-02.scenario: You are Carlos. You work in an office in Budapest, and Meg asks what you think of the new timetable there. You are honest: you do not like it.
b2-01-02.prompt: Give Meg your honest opinion of the new timetable.
cues: Show that you are being frank
Say you do not like the timetable
b2-01-02.target: Francamente, no me gusta el nuevo horario de la oficina.
b2-01-02.english: Frankly, I do not like the new timetable at the office.
b2-01-02.canDo: I can use stance adverbs such as 'francamente' and 'lamentablemente' to show my attitude to a whole sentence.

b2-01-03.title: Communicative Challenge: What Was Decisive
b2-01-03.scenario: You are Meg. You and Carlos live in Budapest. You have passed your exams this year, and Carlos asks what helped you most. You think studying every day was the decisive thing.
b2-01-03.prompt: Tell Carlos what was decisive for your exams.
cues: Say what you did every day
b2-01-03.canDo: I can put an adjective first and the subject after the verb to stress a quality.

b2-01-04.title: Communicative Challenge: Setting It Straight
b2-01-04.scenario: You are Carlos. You work in an office in Budapest. Meg thinks you arrived late because of the traffic, but it was not the traffic: it was the rain.
b2-01-04.prompt: Correct Meg and say what really made you late.
b2-01-04.target: No fue el tráfico, sino la lluvia lo que me retrasó.
b2-01-04.english: It was not the traffic but the rain that made me late.
b2-01-04.canDo: I can correct an assumption with 'no ... sino' and give the right alternative.

b2-01-05.title: Communicative Challenge: Why Read Borges
b2-01-05.scenario: You are Meg. You and Carlos live in Budapest. You have read a text about a story by Borges, and Carlos asks why people still read it. What readers like most is the idea of many possible futures.
b2-01-05.prompt: Tell Carlos what readers like most about the story.
b2-01-05.target: Lo que más les gusta a los lectores es la idea de muchos futuros posibles.
b2-01-05.english: What readers like most is the idea of many possible futures.
b2-01-05.canDo: I can read a short text about a writer and his best-known story and answer questions about it.

b2-01-consolidation.title: Communicative Challenge: Not Money but Teamwork
b2-01-consolidation.scenario: You are Carlos. You work in an office in Budapest, and Meg asks what mattered most in your last project. It was not the money but the teamwork.
b2-01-consolidation.prompt: Tell Meg what mattered most in your last project.
b2-01-consolidation.target: Lo que más importó no fue el dinero, sino el trabajo en equipo.
b2-01-consolidation.english: What mattered most was not the money but the teamwork.
b2-01-consolidation.canDo: I can use cleft sentences with 'lo que' and 'fue ... quien / donde / cuando'.
